name: Transformer pressure-relief operated indication
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Reports operation of the installed pressure-relief device independently of electrical fault detection.
description: Reports operation of the installed pressure-relief device independently of electrical fault detection. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Relief-device contact” at the input and “Pressure-relief operation alarm” at the output. The indication does not identify the fault location.
